limitations: The replay uses the lab tree's selector; production runs an older release (drift reported per run: frontierPipeline, frontierEditor, frontierMix).
October rows scored before the 2026-10-25 rescoring carry no score version and cannot be threshold-selected; replay fidelity against production's real picks was 0.20 for early October.
The safety guard (lost safety picks) cannot fire through a replay: safety items stay selected in every arm.
The registered pick weight (3) decides the endpoint; with weight 1 the October rehearsal preferred 68.
No bundle is imported into production in this phase; incident campaigns need the OSS channels.
